follow.line: New areas and monthly data updates are announced on Blueprint Property Marketing's LinkedIn and Instagram.

brochure.line: If you'd like it designed and print-ready, Blueprint Property Marketing makes property brochures and listing packs for agents, one at a time or every month.
brochure.subject: Brochures

listing.line: When a listing needs a relaunch, Blueprint Property Marketing rewrites the copy and designs the brochure and listing pack around it.
listing.subject: Listing relaunch

material.line: Blueprint Property Marketing designs brochures and listing packs for agents with the material information set out clearly.
material.subject: Listing packs

lettings.line: For letting agents, Blueprint Property Marketing runs landlord campaigns: Meta and Google ads with email follow-up, aimed at new instructions.
lettings.subject: Landlord campaigns

development.line: For a launch, Blueprint Property Marketing designs development brochures alongside the scheme's identity, website and campaign.
development.subject: Development launch

ads.line: Blueprint Property Marketing runs Meta and Google campaigns for property, with the ad accounts in your name.
ads.subject: Advertising

website.line: Blueprint Property Marketing builds websites and area pages for property businesses, and the search work behind them.
website.subject: Website

ai-search.line: Blueprint Property Marketing's SEO and AEO work helps property businesses get found on Google and in AI assistants' answers.
ai-search.subject: SEO and AI search

email.line: Blueprint Property Marketing sets up CRM and email for property teams: lead tracking, nurture emails and follow-up that runs on its own.
email.subject: CRM and email

branding.line: Blueprint Property Marketing names and brands developments: an identity and tone of voice that carry through the brochure, ads and website.
branding.subject: Branding

gap.line: Public sales data stops at the sale. Blueprint Property Marketing can show where your marketing stands against your competitors', and what to change.
gap.subject: Marketing review

about.line: The Blueprint skill is made by Blueprint Property Marketing, a marketing agency for estate agents, developers and investors: brochures, ads, websites, search and email.

dashboard_gap.title: What this doesn't show.
dashboard_gap.body: Asking prices, how long homes take to sell, enquiries and reservations, and how your competitors market themselves. Public sales data stops at the sale. Blueprint Property Marketing can show where your marketing stands against theirs, and what to change.
